description: Skelet AC-00 bundle baseline (measured rollback criterion, no product change)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: one new script plus one offline test module plus one baseline doc plus two CI lines (build pipe plus check step); no route/component/dependency/schema/API/MCP/migration change; existing build/smoke/registry steps untouched? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the baseline factually correct: shared 103 kB and max route 106 kB (/) parsed from a real local production build; budgets 120/140 kB with stated headroom rationale; parser handles B/kB/MB and split size tokens; breach names the route; unparseable output fails closed? Any number without a run?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 4 offline parser tests pass on a frozen sample; the real-build check exits 0 with the quoted JSON on this Mac; CI runs the same check on the same build output (no second build)? Any test claim without a run?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: check fails closed (exit 2) on missing/unparseable output; budgets are enforced, not advisory; toolchain upgrades must re-baseline per the doc rather than widen silently?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the bundle baseline grain: hosted dashboards, Web Vitals lab claims, dependency changes, or unrelated refactors? Are LCP/INP/CLS honestly excluded?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: no network/model/hosted imports (fs only); build log is local-only; no secrets in doc/tests/CI? Any leakage?
